You will work for a growing food production company specializing in preserved food products packaged in stand-up pouches and jars. Quality, safety, and teamwork are at the heart of everything we do.

- Assist the machine operator during production processes

Requirements

- You speak and understand English or Dutch
- You have your own transportation
- You live within a 20 km radius of Nieuwkuijk

Ready to hit the road? Drive for Albert Heijn delivery service and become the ultimate hero of the neighborhood, delivering fresh groceries and big smiles right to the front door! 🚚

At Tempo-Team, we love getting things done—but always on your terms. Looking for freedom? Check! A great salary? Double check! Within no time (after just 13 weeks), you'll be making up to € 18.83 gross per hour (21+) 💰.

Sounds like the perfect match for you? Don't wait around! Apply today and let’s get this show on the road! 🚀

What we offer
- Get € 18,83 per hour after 13 weeks!
- A chance to get a contract with Albert Heijn!
- Bring a friend and get € 200!
- Nice opportunities to grow!
- A pleasant work atmosphere!
- Get travel allowance and a pension plan!

Who you are
As a driver at the delivery service, nothing beats the feeling of being out on the open road and brightening someone's day! 😊 To thrive in this role, you should be physically fit and comfortable lifting crates weighing up to fifteen kilos. 💪 In addition to that:

- You have transportation to get to Kanaaldijk 3 in Utrecht 🚗🚲
- You speak Dutch or English (or both 😉)
- You have a B driver’s license (stick shift)
- able to lift 15 kilo

What will you do
At the Albert Heijn delivery service, you’ll be the one hitting the pavement to bring fresh groceries straight to people's homes! 🍉🧀🥦 Since you work independently, you have total control over which playlist is blasting through the speakers. 🎶 Your shift always kicks off at Kanaaldijk 3, where your van is already packed and waiting for you. Once you’ve grabbed your keys and your route at the dispatch point, it’s time to get moving! 🚚 At every stop, you simply load the right crates onto your trolley to keep the heavy lifting to a minimum. Then, you’ll greet your customers with a big smile and bring the shopping right to their front door. 🏠 After a quick check to ensure the payment is settled, you’ll say your goodbyes and head off to the next happy customer!
